market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil shock + CPI pickup + Fed hike expectation create headwinds. 10-year at 5% pressures equities and CRE. BTC weakness and diesel at $6 signal broad cost pressure. Watch for oil spike to $110+ if Houthi threats escalate. Defensive rotation into energy, pharma, and income likely continues.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI infrastructure, energy transition (despite Europe storage gap), and pharma innovation. Higher-for-longer rates normalize valuations but reward quality and yield. BRICS/India realignment creates 3-5 year trade flow shifts. CRE sector faces structural refinancing overhang but industrial net lease remains resilient.
